description: Look up US tariff rates for multiple HS codes or product keywords in one call. Accepts comma-separated or space-separated inputs (e.g. '8703.24 8471.30 laptop') and returns each match with stacked 2026 rates plus Chinese labels. Use when comparing landed cost across several products.

queries.description: Comma- or space-separated HS codes / product keywords, e.g. '8703.24, 8471.30, laptop, steel pipe'. Max 10 items.

name: tariff.batch
